lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows. The centroids in the mid-flank are smaller and more densely packed, while posterior centroids increase in diameter and spatial separation.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting with the circular blobs to form a regular grid pattern, most distinct in the mid-to-posterior section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank. These features are defined by linear specular highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and corresponding low-luminance shadow gradients on the ventral-facing edge.
